extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: Arabic-Nougat is a suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. The paper also introduces arabic-img2md, a synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, and arabic-books, a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1 [cs.CL], 19 Nov 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset, arabic-img2md, was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to form paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs and paired with extracted Markdown text; the paper also mentions a dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetic page-Markdown pairs were created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text for 13.7k Arabic book page/Markdown pairs.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The older arabic-small-nougat model occasionally generates irrelevant content, including non-existent URLs or images, due to its early training methodology and smaller training dataset; Both arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat exhibit repetition issues, particularly in lengthy sequences; The computational resources required for training arabic-large-nougat are significant, which could limit accessibility for researchers and practitioners without access to high-performance hardware; Its performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested; Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The open-sourcing of arabic-books, a 1.1 billion-token dataset extracted from Arabic literature, provides a valuable resource for future research in Arabic NLP and OCR; By addressing these issues and continuing to refine our models, we aim to contribute to the broader field of document parsing and promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text; knowledge base creation; information retrieval; training data generation; Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction tasks; general text extraction tasks; lengthy or complex documents; downstream NLP tasks
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The arabic-img2md dataset is described as a synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
